note: The EXTERNAL anchor for the arm C blocked-call audit. Fill this in AFTER pushing the commit that contains the canonical worksheets and SHA256SUMS-audit-armC.txt to the public repository, and BEFORE sending anything to a rater. Until public_commit_sha and public_repo_url are set, `rzp-study predistribute-armC` refuses to print the rater messages and AUDIT-armC.md states that no public anchor exists.
why: The local hash check is a workflow-integrity control. It catches an uncommitted edit or a stale tree. It cannot stop or reveal a deliberate local history rewrite carrying the worksheet and the sums file together, so local HEAD is not evidence to anyone outside this machine.

verification.note: Each step below was executed and its output recorded. An earlier version of this field described verifying dc204416... while this record already declared 65f97b0... as the anchor, so it did not verify the commit it asked anyone to trust.

step_1_external_branch_resolution.meaning: The branch tip published at that moment. The tip ADVANCES with every normal commit, including the one carrying this record. It is evidence that the anchor was published, not a value expected to stay constant.

step_2_anchor_is_ancestor_of_published_t.meaning: The anchor is contained in the published branch. This stays true for every later tip on master, so it does not decay as the branch grows.

step_3_worksheet_blobs_at_the_anchor.meaning: Hashed straight out of the anchor commit's tree, not from the working directory. Both files share one blob because they are byte-identical by design -- every rater must see the same rows.

verification.what_this_does_not_establish: That the repository will not be rewritten again. A force-push can move a public branch, and this project has done so. The durable evidence a rater holds is the SHA-256 in their own distribution message, which the author cannot reach.

superseded_anchor.status: SUPERSEDED - not the anchor. Retained for provenance only.
superseded_anchor.why: Recorded as the anchor, then invalidated by a history rewrite before anything was distributed. cmd_preflight was refusing the repository's own history: N9's test fixture was written literally into run.sh and matched the rule preflight enforces. The fixture is now assembled at runtime. No rater ever held a hash tied to this SHA.

withdrawn.status: WITHDRAWN. The worksheets recorded here were never distributed and no labels were ever collected. AUDIT-armC.md does not exist.
withdrawn.reason: Post-hoc rather than pre-registered, and it would have reported one conditional quantity that is neither precision nor recall. Arm E answers the same question pre-registered and with independent labels; a second, weaker label study afterwards would add paperwork rather than evidence.
withdrawn.label_independent_finding_extracted: Of the 72 refusals, nine asked for an amount reachable only by combining ten actions, two past maxSetSize = 8. Reproduce with `rzp-study reachability-armC`; it needs no raters.
withdrawn.artifacts_preserved: The worksheets, sums file, protocol and this record are kept as the historical record of a study that was designed and then stopped.
